name: subtract
description: FlagOS #6612. OpenCV CUDA reference opencv_contrib@b67a855188a3d683813731010f6d39ac614733a4/modules/cudaarithm/src/cuda/sub_mat.cu. Subtract b from a. Float32 uses ordinary subtraction. Uint8 saturates to zero on underflow. The tensors are nonempty equally shaped contiguous single-channel HxW matrices of the same dtype (float32 or uint8), without a mask. Write every element of the independent preallocated destination and return it. Preserve the source tensors.
